description: This file defines a singly linked list implementation in Kotlin, including node management, element addition, removal, size calculation, and element retrieval by index.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A custom singly linked list class with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A nested private class representing each node in the linked list, holding data and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if index is invalid.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Private companion object method to get the last node in the list starting from the head.
